audit.concept_explanation: Series-parallel circuit with a 10V DC source. R1 (2 Ω) is connected in series with the parallel pair R2 (4 Ω) and R3 (6 Ω). Equivalent resistance Req = R1 + (R2·R3)/(R2+R3) = 2 + 2.4 = 4.4 Ω. Total current from source I = 10 / 4.4 = 2.27 A.

R2 = 4 Ω extracted from first parallel branch.
